neighbours.label: a cooking step that sets up a short stretch of time (cook for, simmer for, let it cool, let it rest), as against recipe steps that name an ingredient or a place instead
fire: Pour in the stock, cover the pot and let it simmer for a while.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool before slicing.
Toss the shrimp in the hot oil and fry them for a minute or so.
Take the roast out of the oven and let it rest before carving.
Add the spinach to the pan and cook it for another minute.
Lift the cookies onto a wire rack and leave them to cool.
Stir the rice once, then let it steam for a few minutes.
Whisk the eggs into the sauce and heat it for a moment longer.
quiet: Pour in the stock, add the carrots and a bay leaf to the pot.
Remove the bread from the oven and brush the top with butter.
Toss the shrimp in the hot oil with garlic and lemon zest.
Take the roast out of the oven and place it on a big board.
Add the spinach to the pan along with the grated cheese.
Lift the cookies onto a plate and dust them with sugar.
Stir the rice once, then add the peas and the chicken.
Whisk the eggs into the sauce with a pinch of salt and pepper.
